clusters.name: Walter's move to Sorrel Valley, 1952-1953
clusters.reason: Within about a year of the move from Millbrook to Sorrel Valley you said June's homesickness and letters to Edna, Walter out in the trees from dark to dark, Glen's fights at the new school, Walter's cutoff from his brother over the land money, June's weeks in bed and the rows over money for new trees pile up close together, settling once June joined the choir in 1953; Faye's stomach aches and Roy being kept back a year are left out since nobody is sure of their dates.

clusters.name: Walter's orchard failing, 1968-1969
clusters.reason: Within a few months of the orchard failing in May 1968 you said Walter's heavy drinking, his blaming Glen over the loan, the auction and move to Ridgeport, Glen and Marian taking over the family's money, Carl's worse asthma, your bedwetting beginning again and Ida's heart trouble, settling by late 1969 once Walter stopped drinking and took up pruning work; the cutoff between Walter and Roy and Tess's nightmares are left out since nobody agrees on their dates.

clusters.name: Glen's job loss at the cannery, 1975-1976
clusters.reason: Within months of Glen losing his job when the cannery closed you said his months out of work, the loud fights with Marian over money, the second job cleaning offices, your not eating properly, your keeping to your room away from your mother and Walter's return to drinking, settling once Glen started the delivery job and you were eating again and on the track team; Carl's time at Gail's family's house and Tess's nightmares are left out since nobody is sure of their dates.

clusters.name: Wilma's move into Nora and Hollis's house, 1990-1991
clusters.reason: Within months of Wilma selling her farm and moving into your house you said the clashes over the children's bedtimes, Hollis working late and away from the rows, Hollis taking his mother's side, Owen's tantrums at preschool, Wilma taking over Lily's care, your eczema, the nightly rows with Hollis, settling once Wilma took her own flat and the eczema cleared; your mother's drives over to take your side are left out since nobody is sure of the date.
